public_contract.compatibility: Every existing JVM declaration and constructor retained in original class; no appended constructor parameter, required factory member, sealed error variant, or public native type.
public_contract.source: Explicit immutable declaration conservatively rejects reserved content identifier after comments stripped; native compiler validates source. Reuses ShaderProgram/ShaderDefinition/ParameterSchema. Explicit image bindings borrowed. No backdrop capture or implicit dummy child.
public_contract.identity: Wrappers compare by definition reference; provider/factory/playback replacement keyed by reference even if equals overridden. Values validated against exact schema. Nullable playback reference participates even when phase stays0.
public_contract.preflight: Built-in factory/API support checked before values/uniforms/frame providers. Third-party builtins-only renderer unavailable; query metadata UNKNOWN unless provider opted in. Effect=null BACKGROUND general route supported Skia/Android33+; any ShaderEffect rejected for wrong output; RAW/NESTED remain unsupported.
public_contract.drawing: Draw own rectangular pixel bounds behind drawContent in otherwise empty sized Box. Premultiplied alpha preserved. Outer clip shapes background+foreground. Padding before excludes/after includes draw bounds. Actual measured density/resize feeds resolution. Zero size no providers. First layout can precede snapshot.
public_contract.playback: External ShaderPlayback required only for time bindings; frameProvider required exactly for frame declarations. Explicit inputRevision while paused. No polling/continuous frames without external advancing owner. Host lifecycle/reduced-motion inputs remain external.
public_contract.fallback: Any failed whole replacement clears previous background and draws supplied ordinary Brush or transparent default; foreground retained, onError observed. No partial/missing-input success. onReady only native snapshot creation, not GPU presentation.
public_contract.ownership: Composition owns per-consumer snapshots; Skia uses compiled LRU with temporary builder closed and owned shader closed idempotently on replacement/disposal. Android fresh RuntimeShader per snapshot, colors structural/bound once; can compile every frame. Factory/playback/images remain caller-owned; no throughput/memory stabilization claim.
public_contract.workbench: Shared project/schema/codec/generator, explicit valid Content/Background choices, premultiplied .65 procedural starter, format2 output with format1 CONTENT backward read, exact-run last-good promotion after native creation+matching draw invocation. Failed/stale candidates retain last-good preview/export. Actual generated static/animated/image/live complete background Kotlin compiled in external consumer and retains .375 edited values, source/inputs/tile modes.
